response.path_description: Build the hand skills and musical basics to play songs you love on the acoustic guitar.

milestones.title: Guitar Setup and Posture
milestones.description: Holding the guitar, tuning, and reading chord diagrams and tabs.

milestones.title: Your First Chords
milestones.description: E minor, G, C, D and A minor; clean finger placement and chord changes.

milestones.title: Strumming and Rhythm
milestones.description: Down-up strumming patterns, keeping time with a metronome and counting beats.

milestones.title: Barre Chords and Fingerstyle
milestones.description: F and B minor barre chords and simple fingerpicking patterns.

milestones.title: Playing Full Songs
milestones.description: Combine chords and rhythm to play complete songs from start to finish.

milestones.title: Performance Piece
milestones.description: Learn one song well enough to record or play it for friends.
